brand_overview.market_positioning: Replaces traditional bulky first-aid supplies with touch-free, spray-on delivery for immediate pain relief, infection control, and protective wound sealing.
brand_overview.general_directions: Shake canister thoroughly before each use. Hold 5 cm away from the target area and spray evenly. Allow to air-dry.

product_lineup.primary_mechanism: Cetrimide acts as a cationic surfactant antiseptic to sanitize the wound bed, while Lidocaine provides rapid local anesthesia. Dries into a transparent, flexible, breathable, and waterproof protective film over cuts and abrasions.

Synergistic combination of elemental iodine release and quick-evaporating ethanol. Delivers broad-spectrum microbicidal activity against bacteria, viruses, fungi, and spores without friction or touch contact.

product_lineup.dosage_strength: 7 Natural Herbal Essential Oils Complex (Wintergreen, Camphor, Menthol, Eucalyptus, Turpentine, Clove & Cinnamon Oils)
product_lineup.primary_mechanism: Deep-penetrating counter-irritant and anti-inflammatory action. Rapidly relieves acute muscle soreness, joint sprains, backache, and localized swelling from insect bites.
